name: zoralive-platform
description: ZoraLive - Real-time Voice Party, Live Video Streaming, PK Battle & Party Games Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,APP -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
